summary: Aya Gold & Silver furnished a Form 6-K containing its Q3-2026 earnings press release, MD&A, condensed interim financial statements and CEO/CFO certifications under Canadian Form 52-109F2. Results showed revenue of $103M (up 90% YoY), net income of $35M and operating cash flow of $48M, on 1.7 Moz AgEq sold at a $59.50/oz consolidated realized price. Zgounder guidance narrowed to 5.6–5.8 Moz silver, raising the low end. No transaction, ownership, board recommendation or structural event is present; this is a routine quarterly reporting filing with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
